title: HTML artifact payload
description: A self-contained HTML document to review, inline as `html` or as a file sent beside the payload as `file`: inline styles, data-URI images and fonts. External resources do not load inside the view.

title.description: What the artifact is, shown above it

html.description: The document, complete with <style> elements; or send it as `file`

file.description: The document as an .html file sent with --attach, for one too big to inline or already on disk; instead of `html`

notes.description: What the agent wants the reviewer to look at, as markdown

viewport.description: The width to open the artifact at; the reviewer can switch
